verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents authorizing transactions with your own system instead of its credit core or authorizer. It also offers a fallback in which Pomelo approves transactions when your services are slow to respond, which covers the core of real-time decisioning plus a timeout fallback. Both are one-line guide summaries, though, so the mechanics are not shown. Missing for 10: the endpoint/webhook contract your code answers, the network time budget or timeout value, how you configure or control the fallback, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can approve or decline each authorization in real time — a webhook or auth-stream endpoint my code answers inside the network's time budget, with a documented timeout fallback I control

citations.quote: Autorizar y ajustar transacciones sin usar nuestro Core de crédito o Autorizador.
Mejora tu tasa de aprobación permitiendo que autoricemos transacciones cuando tus servicios demoren en responder.
Recibirás las transacciones de tipo Reversal y Refund a través del endpoint de Ajustes.
